messages.subject: Gadgets: Is it possible to have UI content shareable by all tabs of a miniTabstripPanel?
parts: I want to create a gadget that has a few tabs, but also has a UI section that should remain consistent in the gadget.  In a regular shiny app that's not a problem, but I can't figure out how to do this in a gadget?  Can someone please point me in the right direction?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Gadgets: Is it possible to have UI content shareable by all tabs of a miniTabstripPanel?
parts:
I'd love to get Joe's opinion on what's wrong with doing it the naive way.

If I just add a div inside a miniPage() before the tabs, it will show up above the tabs, and everything seems to work fine. I know the documentation online says that there are only a few select things that should go directly inside a miniPage(), but what happens if I do the following? (And what workaround is there?)

ui <- miniPage(
  div(
    id = "myheader",
    "Content that will be shared by all tabs"
  ),
  
  miniTabstripPanel(
    miniTabPanel("Tab1", icon = icon("globe"),
                 "tab1"
    ),
    miniTabPanel("Tab2", icon = icon("search"),
                 "tab2"
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
}
runGadget(ui, server)
